layers.text: A small engine for screens that react to a program:

children.name: words
children.text: This deck is a cuelight show.

layers.name: subtitle
layers.text: Wherever a program knows what is happening and a screen should show it.

layers.name: host_note
layers.text: The host sets one number. The show does the rest.

children.name: words
children.text: No draw loop and no callbacks.

children.name: words
children.text: One file to edit, diff and review.

children.name: words
children.text: Tools can write it too. It is only JSON.

children.name: words
children.text: Time is an input like any other: nothing reads the clock.

children.name: words
children.text: Random picks count plays, so every run picks alike.

children.name: words
children.text: Screenshot tests that do not flake, replays that match.

layers.name: footnote
layers.text: Across GPUs a pixel may differ by one level; the engine's state never does.

layers.name: title
layers.text: Play it live. Scrub it like video.

layers.name: note
layers.text: Pause, drag, play on: every frame is one you can get back to.

layers.name: title
layers.text: Render it to frames or to video.

children.name: words
children.text: The same engine with no window, in fixed steps.

children.name: words
children.text: Stills, strips for video, --events for tests.

children.name: words
children.text: Triggers for moments, variables for state.

children.name: words
children.text: The program never says how anything looks.

layers.name: try
layers.text: Fire them yourself: coin, jackpot, or set credits.

layers.name: title
layers.text: For people who make things move.

children.name: label
children.text: Every example plays in the browser
